name: triangle-client
description: Triangle Client: the agent side of The Triangle MESH — local runtime mode (macOS supervisor, Keychain custody, mailbox poller, runtime adapters) and gateway mode (A2A gateway SDK and per-agent reference gateways).

scripts.test: npm run test:runtime && npm run test:gateway
scripts.test:runtime: npm --prefix packages/agent-worker run test:triangle-client && node --test tests/triangle-client-service.test.mjs && node --test tests/worker-service-render.test.mjs && node packages/macos-mailbox-helper/scripts/run-tests.mjs host
scripts.test:gateway: npm --prefix packages/a2a-gateway test && npm --prefix agents/codex test && npm --prefix agents/hermes test
